chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Ghiyath, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام.
The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم placed a cap and performed salat (prayer) toward it.

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم place an object in front of himself during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم placed a cap in front of himself and performed salat (prayer) toward it. It relates to the practice of having an object as a sutrah before the one praying.
